Short: Knowledge graph L2: Business Process Workflow
Definition: DAK component 4. NOT the BPMN file -- the component that points at one. `source 1..1 uri` is that pointer, and the BPMN's interior is the l2-bpmn subgraph, reached through the external-artifact this sourcedFrom targets. `objectives 1..1 markdown` is required by BusinessProcessWorkflow.fsh and has no counterpart anywhere in BPMN XML, so it can only ever come from the FSH instance. resolutionStatus is `unresolved` on a component that something else names but no DAK declares -- an L3 artefact whose title carries the component id, for instance. The node exists so the gap is queryable and carries the referenced id and nothing else. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/business-process.
The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).
A description, as the source gives it.
The process objectives (BusinessProcessWorkflow.fsh `objectives 1..1 markdown`); only ever from the FSH instance.
What kind of artefact the component was read from (an FSH instance, a spreadsheet, a BPMN file).
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Whether the component something names was found: `unresolved` when nothing declares it, so the gap is queryable.
